messages:
erica: Heads-up — seeing a big telemetry spike out of eu-west starting ~00:12 UTC. coincides with a handful of node reboots and we hit our egress budget for the region. logs volume up ~3x

jonas: Can you drop the grafana panel? suspect prom scrape or kube churn causing repeats

erica: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abcd123/telemetry-overview?orgId=1 - look at ingest egress & log-forwarder errors around 00:12. also CPU on log-forwarder pods spiked

lee: Confirmed from node logs — 3 kubelets reconnected after a kernel update. rapid reconnects + log-forwarder backpressure -> retries -> amplification. forwarder buffer spilled to disk and retried loudly.

monica: Our current alert for telemetry_ingest_errors is 30m burn. that's too slow for this amplification. proposal: add a short burn-rate alert (5m) and a critical for 2m. page on critical.

erica: Immediate mitigations I propose:
- apply temporary sampling on eu-west: sample debug/traces envelopes 95%
- reduce prom scrape frequency for debug-only metrics (60s -> 120s)
- update forwarder to drop-on-overflow + exponential backoff tweak
- canary the forwarder change to 2 nodes in eu-west-1a first

tara: Make sure sampling doesn't drop PII-sensitive payloads. we need a pre-sample redaction hook that strips/hashed user inputs and embeddings fields before sampling. otherwise we risk losing redacted context.

siva: Product note: losing debug traces for a short window is acceptable. prefer preserving stderr/error-level logs though.

jonas: Draft forwarder config snippet and JSON envelope tweak below — pre-sample redaction is an added hook in the pipeline: 
```
# forwarder.conf (snippet)
pipeline: 
  - name: redact-hook
    type: lua
    script: /etc/logforwarder/hooks/redact_inputs.lua
  - name: sampler
    type: probabilistic
    keep: ["error", "warn"]
    sample_rate: 0.05
  - name: drop_on_overflow
    type: drop
    threshold_mb: 200
  - name: http_out
    url: https://ingest.redwood.internal/eu-west/v1/envelopes
```

# new minimal envelope fields (for compacting)
{
  "v": 2,
  "ts": 0,
  "svc": "model-serving",
  "lvl": "info",
  "msg": "inference.ok",
  "meta": {"gpu_id":"g-23","region":"eu-west-1"},
  "payload": {"kind":"trace","k": "..."}
}
```

jonas: note: redact hook should `hash` any `user_input` and `embedding_vectors` keys before the sampler runs.

lee: For rollout: I'll patch DaemonSet with the new forwarder image + config and label two nodes with `telemetry-canary=true`. kubectl patch will do. command: `kubectl rollout restart ds/log-forwarder -n telemetry --selector=telemetry-canary=true`

monica: Alert tuning I'll apply: warning if ingest_error_rate > 0.5% for 10m, critical if >2% for 2m. Also add synthetic canary that emits a small envelope every 30s to validate path.

telemetry-bot: deploy-bot: forwarder-config-v2 rolled to canary (eu-west-1a) at 1950117805 :white_check_mark:

erica: Thanks — monitoring next 2 hours. I'll open the runbook PR with rollback steps, commands, and the prom/grafana dashboard edits. tagging @oncall and @platform-eng.

tara: I'll review the redact hook and sign off on the PR once the hash algorithm and retention are documented.

siva: Thanks everyone. keep pager if things worsen.
_note: This thread covers region telemetry spike, forwarder sampling, redaction hook, prom/grafana alerts, and a canary rollout plan.
